# `edit.flip`: Flip normals

Reverses the facing of every connected part that contains a selected face.

- Category: edit
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(V + F + C) to find parts plus O(c log c) per flipped part
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: flip, flip normals, reverse normals, invert normals, polyNormal reverse

Faces always agree with their neighbours, so whole connected parts flip: the inside becomes the outside. To flip only some faces, `edit.split` them off first.

**Use for** rooms and interiors seen from inside, or deliberately inward shells. To make everything face outward, use `edit.recalc_normals` instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Faces whose connected parts are flipped; every part when omitted. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"target":"bin"}
```

Result: `bin (o:5): flipped 1 part (5 faces)`
